description: Institut plánování a rozvoje hlavního města Prahy: flood hazard datasets is a collection of datasets listed in Czech National Open Data Portal, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Institut plánování a rozvoje hlavního města Prahy. Coverage: Institut plánování a rozvoje hlavního města Prahy. The listing groups 7 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about flood hazard; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Záplavové území (Vltava, Berounka); Záplavové území ( drobné vodní toky ); Záplavové území 2013; Záplavové území ( Q100 ). Formats seen: JSON, GEOJSON, ZIP, CSV, HTML. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://data.gov.cz/zdroj/datové-sady/70883858/9a8782843c2607f837f4567e47b37413/distribuce/68b4934adb8132f78d2d9a18cdfded5a/podmínky-užití), as linked on the portal listing (https://data.gov.cz/zdroj/datové-sady/70883858/61eb1c6d7efebe0eac91340c5e22e6d8/distribuce/418797e80ec8eeba02c3c90c950fecac/podmínky-užití), as linked on the portal listing (https://data.gov.cz/zdroj/datové-sady/70883858/9352b87581e1979fa15a949ba3523599/distribuce/cabb8bee97317650e392ddc7bf1ce84c/podmínky-užití). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-nkod-opendata-cz.
